summary:
What adventures we have had since I last wrote you. The court thing in Marin County came out okay—I guess I haven’t written you to tell you that, have I? Tess and I had an exciting time in San Francisco, and we decided to move there. That was a long time ago, though, well over a month—that plan has left our heads by now, what with all the action going on around us. Mainly, I’ve gotten back to writing, for the first time in two years; I sent off 127 pages to my agent, half a novel called, THE DARK­ HAIRED GIRL, consisting mostly of letters written February to November. Including one to you, Jamis, and a lot about you in other letters to other people. It is non-science and non-fiction. I haven’t heard from my agent yet as to how he likes it Probably no one will buy it but anyhow I have sent him something. I also sent off a 19 page article on the same subject 
Ah, Jamis. Tess and I are so tired, what with all the writing, including many business letters. Tess is now acting as my executive secretary, handling much of my correspondence for me. Our life has become so professional and intense. No more mere light trippy rapping with Linda and so forth. Where will it go to even­ tually? We seem to be surrounded by violence always, which we both hate but can’t escape. This is a sick society here. Nice things happen but are at once snuffed out, as if by a long-term wind. Should I tell you what’s happened to us? It’d make you cry.
